product_metadata.title: Footprints in The Sand Inspirational Wall Art, Beach Decor, Christian Gifts for Women and Men, Christian Wall Decor, Get Well Soon, Encouraging Scripture Wall Art, Framed Sympathy Gift 8639BW
features: FOOTPRINTS IN THE SAND WALL ART will provide encouragement and comfort through difficult times. This is a heartwarming gift for those who have lost a loved one, sympathy, condolence, or memorial gift. The frame will fit well as Christian wall decor for bedroom or wall decorations for living room.

LET THIS BEACH THEMED FRAME fill your home with inspirational quotes and Christian decor for the daily reminder that God is always with you wherever you go and whatever you do. Great Christmas or birthday gifts for women, husband or wife, mother or father, sister or brother or your best friend.

THIS INSPIRATIONAL WALL DECOR will give a get well wish and hope to those who are in recovery, facing illness, receiving chemotherapy or struggling with life. This framed art would be very suitable cancer gifts for women or men, or those dealing with a long-term disability. "When you looked back on the journey of your life and saw only one set of footprints, it was then that I carried you" is a very powerful statement.

THINKING OF YOU GIFT that is rich in meaning will lift the spirits and give hope to those who see it every day. This sentimental gift for a friend may be just what they need to remember where they have been so they can see that hope in their future.

OUR PROMISE is that you will be completely satisfied with your order. We will make and pack your frame with care, but if you have any concerns, connect with us through your order page and we will make it right! Our frames Include glass front and easel back with easy to use wall hanger. The finished frame size is 10"x10" and holds an 8”x8” print. Proudly made in the USA.

details.Special Feature: INSPIRE, ENCOURAGE and CONNECT to show you care. This inspirational work of art will give everyone who sees it as an encouraging word for the day. Each frame is carefully packed and shipped to you or whomever you choose to ship it to. The front is real glass and will protect the print inside from fingerprints and dust.
details.Included Components: Frame, Glass, Print, Easel Back, Wall Hanger, Easel Back for Wall or Tabletop Display
